why_cant_you_quit_video.mp4.description:
Ever wonder why you can't stop a bad habit even when you completely hate doing it?

Most people think addiction is about chasing pleasure. But neuroscientist Kent Berridge proved the exact opposite:

In your brain, LIKING (pleasure) and WANTING (craving) are two completely separate systems.

Here is how the trap works:
1. LIKING is powered by fragile opioid hotspots in the nucleus accumbens.
2. WANTING is driven by massive mesolimbic dopamine pathways.
3. Over time, pleasure crashes due to tolerance—but dopamine pathways become HYPER-SENSITIZED to environmental cues.

Result? Your brain screams with irresistible craving, even when the experience delivers zero joy.

You aren't weak. You are trapped in wanting.
